resources.string: USB devices
Manage Native iPhone and Userspace Linux USB access

Native and Userspace Linux support terminal-usb list, iphone and tooling commands. Userspace Linux also provides serial, adb, mtp and raw (Python 3 required). Approve requests here, then rerun the command. Enter tool account/2FA only in Host tool inputs. For mounted storage, choose a folder below.

Allow only the selected iPhone operation. Interface -1 means device-level access; the USB configuration may change. Pairing requires unlocking and trusting this app on the iPhone. Unpairing removes this app’s pairing. Android manages credentials without sending them to Userspace Linux. Session exit, unplugging or revocation cancels access. Other iPhone operations require separate approval.
